description.value: Chicken 649 is a Victoria restaurant specializing in Korean Fried Chicken, established in 2017. The kitchen uses fresh, hand-cut chicken marinated in house-blended herbs and spices, with all sauces made in-house from fresh ingredients. Cyclists can eat in, order takeout, or arrange delivery after a ride through the Quadra Street corridor.
